_doc: A pass that needed a retry is a RED: `retries: 1` in CI turns an
intermittent failure into a silent green, and the reporter's `= FLAKY`
line is easy to skim past. Under APEX_FAIL_ON_FLAKY=1 (ci.yml sets it on
every browser job) tests/helpers/live-reporter.js fails the run when a test
passed only on retry — UNLESS its spec is listed here. A listed spec still
runs and its flakes are still printed; it just does not block, and it
carries an owner, a date and the reason, so the quarantine is a ledger and
not a hiding place. tests/unit/flaky-quarantine.test.mjs asserts every
entry names a spec that exists and carries all three fields.
Playwright's own --fail-on-flaky-tests cannot do this: it is all-or-nothing.
Leaving: delete the row in the same commit as the fix. Entering: the row
and the PR that names the flaky test, never a silent add.

quarantine.why: 8 tests, 18.6 min per selected shard, failed 4 of 5 sampled CI runs on one test (09-16 note B2) — CI's dominant flake; the clickLive fix it motivated is still open.

quarantine.owner: tune-physics skill / js/input/steer-tuning.js (racing-line assist and curvature-drift authority)
quarantine.why: 4 of the 14 red ci.yml runs on 2026-09-22, across three branches: 'racing-line assist: PULL eases toward the line, PUSH sends it wider' failed 3x in the oversize-steering lane (runs 35769571096, 35765129621, 35762975987) and 'steering has authority to fight the curvature drift' 1x in Smoke on a deploy-branch dispatch (35753682415); each pass needed a retry or none. 13 tests at 480 s cap, its own runner every time it is selected.
